# Live information recording

An actual `LiveLog` writer produced these unchanged LWLG v1 bytes using the
published format 2 `kind: live`. The clip contains two UTC admission days, a
real Catalog, property observations and schema-valid invocation updates.
Its scene version/hash are null and it has no manifest or spatial frame.

Clocks and protocol messages were injected for this small compatibility
fixture; no Device Host, broker, Source or physical device ran. The immutable
clip preserves the writer's continuous `recording` status. Private ownership
and clock correlation files are excluded. `expected.json` states independent
values, measurement timestamps and invocation durations, including a repeated
roll snapshot whose old measurement time must remain unchanged.
